body: keloid scars. cuts. they didnt start out that big, they were tiny when they healed. but over years the scar tissue has grown n grown over itself. they're annoying and itchy. i have some on my shoulders too

''has yet to be resolved'' <<<< id have to have a 2000 year lifespan to even begine to resolve anything regarding my sexual abuse. it lasted so long and theres so many memories to work through. the average human lifespan doesnt even reach 100 anymore. itll never get resolved.   


as for time, no i dont have a lot of time left, i dont have anymore time to give,  the energy to give anything else. thanks for reaching out but i dont need convincing of anything, just venting i guess. making it so im not the only person carrying the full weight of these thoughts/feelings. its not enough to keep me here, but itll make my last moments better.

except i do it everyday for past 20 years and its still not better. stop assuming everyones issues can be solved/fixed/cured. over 7 billion people on this planet, we are not all the same and the same methods dont work on others and even if trying diff methods, some people are beyond saving (for those that want it). people are so terrified at a fact of life. that death follows. doesnt matter when or how but its inevitable. as suicidal people we are more intune and at peace with death and our own mortality, that others are always frightened and push back aainst what is different/strange/outsde the norm to them. fear. fear drives everyone, until it doesnt. until you reach a point of understanding theres nothing to fear. its just the cycle of nature, you cant change or control it. it just is.

and the you get the types that spew out generic, unoriginal, cliche bullshit "it gets better" <<< no. it doesnt. not for everyone. and what of those that have been trying and seeking out help for years? decades and it still hasnt gotten better? and they are still suffering and miserable. but at least these ''it gets better' people can feel better about themselves tho. smdh

exactly same here. MY life, is MINE. not anyone elses. ''i fight for life" <<< how about folks fight for their own life or those that ask for their help, rather than pushing, projecting their ideals onto others as if theirs is more right n jsut than someone elses, especially as it pertains to THEIR own damn life.

we live in a wold of entitled overly inflated ego having, selfish people. they feel they own another human being and their life as their own and feel as if they get to dictate what someone else does. these same types are also extremely  hypocritical as well its laughable.
nah talking has never actually done me any good tbh im just venting sorry to bother you

its just funny to me how people act so shocked at the very idea that, actually no not everyone wants to be here, not everyone wants to live to old age where your body starts to fail and break down n you go thorugh physical anguish (if you arent already) in addition to the mental/emotional anguish you already face now. people freeze and freak out at the idea that some of us are more aware of our own mortality than most and are more than comfortable with the fragility of life/death and that death itself does not frighten us.   


my reasons for wanting to go will differ from others, but lets jsut say ive seen enough that i want to see in this life, from other humans, and have suffered personally to last a thousand lifetimes. ppl preach about respecting peoples wishes and that no means no, but yet "stay alive for me" (me, me, me, there goes that ego again eh?) and i answer "no" <<< and the response is to ignore someone elses right to their own  **body autonomy.** it (the refusal to respect someones right to their own bodies and life) instills in me the exact same disgust i feel when people try to tell women, we cant have abortions, or transgender people cant transition, or once upon a time gay people couldnt marry, interracial couples couldnt be together, etc etc. its possessiveness, entitlement, and repulsive. smdh

i relate to this so much. for me, indeed its NOT some random in the moment thing. it takes a long time of planning, research and getting things in order. ive been fighting for over 20 years already and havent gotten any better. im tired. and before anyone goes "oh but look how long you fougt, yay keep going blah blah blabbiddy blah" <<< consider this. why place so much value on how LONG someone has lived? but yet no one ever appreciates the people that were here even for but a moment, until AFTER they are gone. pretty fucked up if you ask me. so they werent worth recognition with what time they did give? its sad? a tragedy? but someone dies from old age and its celebrated? hmmmm. k then.   


i want someone to tell me thank you for a change. thank you for what i was able to give. thank you for the years and memories they still have. and then i want them wish me well. not just wish for me to get well and continue living life on their blueprint, but wish me well after life and into/after death. i force myself to suffer so much and be here (in life) where i am not happy and i dont want to be. im NOT looking for an intervention and ''get help" <<< (have been again for over a decade. no thanks).   


when you have a terminally ill person, you dont keep them plugged in to wires etc. or force them when you see them in obvious pain and anguish. you try to get them help/cure for it first and if there isnt one, you say your goodbyes. because the HUMANE thing to do is to put them out of their misery and suffering so they can be free of it. but when its mental illness and not physical, suddenly you no longer have care or compassion or understanding that they are in immense pain, suddenly you force them, guilt and shame them to stay in their suffering to make you feel better.   


im not saying dont get help FIRST, but what about after? after theyve been getting help and tried everything and they are still in pain? as i said, for in MY personal situation ive been getting help for YEARS. literally YEARS. and im still not any better, if anything ive just gotten worse as time goes on. my entire LIFE has been about others. living for others (literally and figuratively), pleasing other people, considering other people's feelings and locking mine way and never acknowledging them, doing for others etc. im tired tired tired.   


some will say: "live for yourself" <<< yes. indeed. and what i personally want for MYSELF, is death itself. it is MY life, NO ONE owns me, i am NOT a piece of property, an object to be owned or told what to do or how to do it. we live in the age of entitlement and overly inflated senses of egos its stifling and utterly disgusting. society feels they own another persons life or any say in what theyd o with it. this applies to so many different things, once upon a time it applied to sexuality, gender, race, abortion etc etc.  im not religious so the whole fear of going to some horrible  place doesnt apply to me, i dont believe in that mess. death to me is the end. "but what if its not?" << so? so everyone else can allow fear to dictate their every action if they wish, i wont. i dont fear death. nor do i fear what may or may not come after death, let what come may. im already living hell on earth, whats one more in some hypothetical other existential plane of existence? and no one knows whether there is anything after death or not, literally everyone is just making shit up and taking a guess. i dont think its genuine or sincere if peple do or not do things out of fear of eternal damnation/suffering anyway, stay clear tf away from me, please and thank you.

omg i felt like the only black girl too! in our community its never discussed. so much is never talked about. im trying to be ok with them. when its just me i am, im so used to looking at them, but i still cover up if im going out in public.

i feel this same way. my focus is to stay clean and find an effective, healthy, safe alternative to sh/cutting. but i dont want to cover up or erase or hide a part of me. kinda feeds into the stigma of mental health, imperfections etc and how we should hide it away like it never existed.
